title: Stability and Bifurcation Analysis of Fractional Delay Differential Equation with a Delay-dependent Coefficient
summary: This paper investigates the stability of different regions in the $(k,γ)$-plane for a class of fractional delay differential equations given by \begin{equation} D^α x(t) = -γx(t) + g\big(x(t - τ_1)\big) - e^{-γτ_2}\, g\big(x(t - τ_1 - τ_2)\big), \qquad 0 0$, $τ_2 \ge 0$, which holds for all values of $α$ and $τ_1$. In addition, illustrative examples are provided in the form of stability diagrams in the $(τ_1,τ_2)$-plane for fixed values of $α$, $k$, and $γ$.
